title: MatFormer granularity Mirror views
hypothesis: Per-layer, per-granularity Mirror gains on a shared nested FFN recover useful unseen mixed-width configurations beyond native nested-width selection, with fewer bytes than independent FFNs and better storage/quality than ordinary gains.
mirror_coordinate: granularity and layer-indexed diagonal hidden activation gain
logical_multiplicity: three homogeneous trained granularities and three locked unseen mixed granularities

development.selection_metric: heldout mix accuracy/NLL, actual serialized bytes, MAC proxy

fresh.reason: Direct coefficient control uses the same diagonal function and serialized state; mirror-specific gate is development-decidable.

storage.authority: actual deterministic NPZ inference payload bytes

success_gate: Mirror unseen-mix accuracy within 2pp of independent bank, >=10% fewer bytes than independent bank, and >=10% byte advantage over direct coefficient at equal quality.
failure_gate: Direct coefficient and Mirror function/payload equivalent, or no held-out mix quality benefit over native nested selection.
boundaries: no language-model or GPU runtime claim
Amendment A1: initial label task was near-uniform/unlearnable; replaced with learnable random linear teacher before adjudication. No fresh results opened.
